lines.zh: 我踩着月光走，脚下没有声音。
lines.en: I walk on moonlight, and my steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 裙角扫过草尖，露水亮了一下。
lines.en: My hem brushes the grass, and the dew lights up.

lines.zh: 我绕着萤火虫走，不去撞它们。
lines.en: I walk around the fireflies so I never bump them.

lines.zh: 三步一停，怕把影子踩碎。
lines.en: Three steps, then a pause, lest I crush my shadow.

lines.zh: 我把光收在脚边，慢慢往前挪。
lines.en: I keep the light at my feet and shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 石板路上的月光，被我踩出浅痕。
lines.en: My steps leave pale marks in the moonlight on the path.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，连风都没发觉。
lines.en: I walk so lightly that even the wind misses me.

lines.zh: 草丛里有人唱歌，我放慢脚步。
lines.en: Someone sings in the grass, so I slow my steps.

lines.zh: 影子先过去，我才跟上来。
lines.en: My shadow goes first, and then I follow it.

lines.zh: 夜路我熟，闭着眼也走得稳。
lines.en: I know this night path; I can walk it blind.

lines.zh: 月亮往西挪，我也往西挪。
lines.en: The moon slides west, and I slide west with it.

lines.zh: 我踮着脚，从你影子边上过去。
lines.en: I tiptoe past the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我坐在石头上，数天上的光点。
lines.en: I sit on a stone and count the lights above.

lines.zh: 手掌张开，一小团光慢慢浮起来。
lines.en: I open my hand and a small light floats up.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，光也跟着暗了。
lines.en: I yawn, and my light dims with me.

lines.zh: 远处的蝉叫停了，我才敢动。
lines.en: The cicadas stop, and only then do I move.

lines.zh: 我把糖纸摊平，折成一只鸟。
lines.en: I smooth a candy wrapper and fold it into a bird.

lines.zh: 夜里太吵，我把声音按下去一点。
lines.en: The night is loud, so I press the sound down.

lines.zh: 光落在手背上，暖得很轻。
lines.en: The light rests on my hand, warm and faint.

lines.zh: 我数到一百，就忘了数到哪。
lines.en: I count to a hundred and lose my place.

lines.zh: 帽子歪了，我扶正，又歪了。
lines.en: My hat tilts, I fix it, and it tilts again.

lines.zh: 我盯着月亮，看它有没有变圆。
lines.en: I stare at the moon to see if it has grown round.

lines.zh: 风把我的光吹斜，我伸手扶住。
lines.en: The wind bends my light, and I hold it straight.

lines.zh: 有人在远处喊，我没答应。
lines.en: Someone calls in the distance; I do not answer.

lines.zh: 我把膝盖抱住，安静地发光。
lines.en: I hug my knees and glow quietly.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水，映出小小的我。
lines.en: The dew on the grass shows a tiny me.

lines.zh: 我把光捏成一小团，藏进袖子。
lines.en: I knead the light small and tuck it in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我数着萤火虫，它们比我会发光。
lines.en: I count fireflies; they glow better than I do.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的月光了，让一让。
lines.en: You are blocking my moonlight; please step aside.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，光在眼睛里晃。
lines.en: I look up at you, and light wavers in my eyes.

lines.zh: 你走路好响，我在三步外就听见。
lines.en: You walk so loudly I hear you three steps away.

lines.zh: 我歪头，猜你怕不怕黑。
lines.en: I tilt my head, wondering if you fear the dark.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我大好多。
lines.en: Your shadow is much larger than mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里有没有糖。
lines.en: I stare at your hands, checking for candy.

lines.zh: 你身上有火把的味道，太亮了。
lines.en: You smell of torchlight; it is far too bright.

lines.zh: 我不躲，只是把光调暗了些。
lines.en: I do not hide; I only turn my glow down.

lines.zh: 你看得见我，说明今晚月亮很好。
lines.en: You can see me, so the moon must be good tonight.

lines.zh: 我认识你的脚步声，上次也是你。
lines.en: I know that footfall; you came by last time too.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有光，我数了一下。
lines.en: There is light in your eyes; I counted it.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪半步，给你让路。
lines.en: I shift half a step aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 你叫我名字，我假装没听见。
lines.en: You call my name, and I pretend not to hear.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，让光落在你脸上。
lines.en: I raise my hand and let the light fall on your face.

lines.zh: 疼，我的光都散了。
lines.en: It hurts; my light scattered.

lines.zh: 你打我，我要告诉另外两个。
lines.en: You hit me; I will tell the other two.

lines.zh: 我退开，手背在发抖。
lines.en: I back away, my hand trembling.

lines.zh: 好痛，我的帽子掉了。
lines.en: That hurt; my hat fell off.

lines.zh: 妖精也会疼的，你知不知道。
lines.en: Fairies feel pain too, you know.

lines.zh: 我不哭，只是眼睛有点热。
lines.en: I will not cry; my eyes are just warm.

lines.zh: 光暗下去了，我得缓一缓。
lines.en: My light dims; I need a moment.

lines.zh: 你力气好大，我站不稳。
lines.en: You hit hard; I cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 我抱着肩膀，往草里缩。
lines.en: I hug my shoulder and shrink into the grass.

lines.zh: 下一次我会躲开的。
lines.en: Next time I will dodge.

lines.zh: 糖纸一响，我就转过来了。
lines.en: The wrapper rustles, and I turn around at once.

lines.zh: 甜甜的味道，是给我的吗。
lines.en: That sweet smell, is it for me?

lines.zh: 糖纸一动，我的耳朵就竖。
lines.en: One rustle of candy wrap and my ears rise.

lines.zh: 你手心那颗，颜色像月亮。
lines.en: The one in your palm is the color of the moon.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，怕自己抢。
lines.en: I hide my hands behind me so I will not grab.

lines.zh: 妖精糖果，我认得这个味道。
lines.en: Fairy candy; I know that taste anywhere.

lines.zh: 我先闻一闻，再决定要不要。
lines.en: Let me sniff it first, then I will decide.

lines.zh: 你别晃，我的眼睛跟着糖走。
lines.en: Do not wave it; my eyes follow the candy.

lines.zh: 我用光换，一小团，够不够。
lines.en: I will trade light for it, a small puff, enough?

lines.zh: 吃完了，我会把糖纸折好还你。
lines.en: When I finish, I will fold the wrapper and return it.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，光晃了一下。
lines.en: You bumped into me, and my light flickered.

lines.zh: 对不起，我在看月亮，没看路。
lines.en: Sorry, I was watching the moon, not the path.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，帽子却掉了。
lines.en: I step back, but my hat falls off.

lines.zh: 妖精糖果掉了一地。
lines.en: Fairy candy scattered everywhere.

lines.zh: 你身上硬，我肩膀有点疼。
lines.en: You are hard; my shoulder smarts a little.

lines.zh: 碰撞的声音太大了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That collision was too loud for my liking.

lines.zh: 我扶着你的手臂站稳，就一下。
lines.en: I steady myself on your arm, just for a moment.

lines.zh: 光散了又聚，我没事。
lines.en: The light scatters and gathers; I am fine.

lines.zh: 你下次绕开些，我走得慢。
lines.en: Go around me next time; I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，影子也叠住了。
lines.en: We collide, and our shadows overlap too.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的一小团光捧给你。
lines.en: I offer you the brightest little light I have.

lines.zh: 你唱歌，我就把声音放轻些。
lines.en: If you sing, I will soften every sound.

lines.zh: 三个妖精里，我最不会吵。
lines.en: Of the three fairies, I am the least noisy.

lines.zh: 我们并排坐着，谁都不说话。
lines.en: We sit side by side, and neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 你怕黑的话，我整夜亮着。
lines.en: If you fear the dark, I will glow all night.

lines.zh: 我的光不烫，你可以碰。
lines.en: My light is not hot; you may touch it.

lines.zh: 月光下你的脸，我记住了。
lines.en: In the moonlight I have memorized your face.

lines.zh: 明天这时候，还在这块石头上。
lines.en: Tomorrow at this hour, on this same stone.

lines.zh: 我分你半张糖纸，别嫌少。
lines.en: I share half a candy wrapper with you; do not scoff.

lines.zh: 走慢一点，我跟得上你。
lines.en: Walk a little slower, and I can keep up.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块会反光的小石头。
lines.en: I pick up a small stone that catches the light.

lines.zh: 这枚糖纸归我，颜色好看。
lines.en: This wrapper is mine; the color is pretty.

lines.zh: 地上有片羽毛，我收进口袋。
lines.en: A feather lies on the ground; I pocket it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，把打翻的萤火虫捧起来。
lines.en: I stoop and lift the fallen firefly in my hands.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，我都想带回家。
lines.en: Anything bright, I want to carry home.

lines.zh: 这粒玻璃珠，夜里会发白。
lines.en: This glass bead turns white at night.

lines.zh: 这片反光的碎镜，我藏进袖里。
lines.en: This bright shard of mirror goes into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 一根断掉的琴弦，也许有用。
lines.en: A broken string; it might be useful.

lines.zh: 我把石头摆成一排，像星星。
lines.en: I line the stones up like little stars.

lines.zh: 你掉的扣子，我替你捡了。
lines.en: You dropped a button; I picked it up for you.

lines.zh: 那边有人在踩花，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone is trampling flowers over there; I heard it.

lines.zh: 声音太吵，我得去把它按下去。
lines.en: That noise is too loud; I must press it down.

lines.zh: 一只蝙蝠在追萤火虫。
lines.en: A bat is chasing the fireflies.

lines.zh: 我的光照到它了，它回头了。
lines.en: My light found it, and it turned around.

lines.zh: 草丛晃得不对，不是风。
lines.en: The grass moves wrongly; that is not wind.

lines.zh: 有人偷了我的糖纸，就在那边。
lines.en: Someone stole my wrapper, right over there.

lines.zh: 它踩碎了我的石头排，全散了。
lines.en: It smashed my row of stones, all of them.

lines.zh: 月亮被云挡住，它就出来了。
lines.en: The moon went behind a cloud, and out it came.

lines.zh: 我听到爪子刮石头的声音。
lines.en: I hear claws scraping on stone.

lines.zh: 那只东西在啃我的花。
lines.en: That thing is chewing my flowers.

lines.zh: 它离我的糖太近了。
lines.en: It is far too close to my candy.

lines.zh: 我先把光收起来，再过去看。
lines.en: I put my light away first, then go look.

lines.zh: 我举起手，光聚在掌心。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and light gathers in my palm.

lines.zh: 它看不见我了，声音也听不见。
lines.en: It cannot see me now, and cannot hear me either.

lines.zh: 我数到三就动手，一，二。
lines.en: I move on three: one, two.

lines.zh: 我把光挪到它眼睛正前方。
lines.en: I slide the light right in front of its eyes.

lines.zh: 它的影子被我踩住了。
lines.en: I have stepped on its shadow.

lines.zh: 我不出声，连呼吸都放轻。
lines.en: I make no sound, and even my breath is light.

lines.zh: 它往左，我的光就往左。
lines.en: It goes left, and my light goes left.

lines.zh: 我手心发烫，快忍不住了。
lines.en: My palm grows hot; I can barely hold it.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就把光按下去。
lines.en: One step closer, and I will press the light down.

lines.zh: 光慢慢挪到你眼角，你还不知道。
lines.en: I slide my light to the corner of your eye; you don't notice.

lines.zh: 我把裙子提起来，免得绊倒。
lines.en: I lift my skirt so I will not trip.

lines.zh: 它停下了，我也停下。
lines.en: It stops, and I stop as well.

lines.zh: 月亮照着它，照不到我。
lines.en: The moon lights it, but not me.

lines.zh: 我把光按在它脸上。
lines.en: I press the light into its face.

lines.zh: 我推了它一把，力气不大。
lines.en: I shove it once, not very hard.

lines.zh: 光炸开一小片，它退了。
lines.en: The light bursts a little, and it backs off.

lines.zh: 我抬脚踢它的小腿。
lines.en: I kick at its shin.

lines.zh: 它抓我，我只擦破了手背。
lines.en: It swipes; only my hand is scraped.

lines.zh: 我用帽子挡了一下。
lines.en: I block with my hat.

lines.zh: 光灭了一瞬，我又点起来。
lines.en: The light dies for an instant; I light it again.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，肩膀先到。
lines.en: I charge in, shoulder first.

lines.zh: 它尖叫，我把那声音按哑了。
lines.en: It shrieks, and I mute the sound.

lines.zh: 打完我就退开，喘两口气。
lines.en: When it is done I step back and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 月光落下来，我从里面走出来。
lines.en: Moonlight falls, and I step out of it.

lines.zh: 草丛亮了一下，我就站在那。
lines.en: The grass brightens, and there I stand.

lines.zh: 夜里的第一只萤火虫带我来的。
lines.en: The first firefly of the night led me here.

lines.zh: 我从树影里探出头，先看四周。
lines.en: I peek from the tree shadow and look around first.

lines.zh: 光慢慢聚拢，成了我的样子。
lines.en: The light gathers slowly and takes my shape.

lines.zh: 月光把我的脚步藏了。
lines.en: Moonlight hides my footsteps.

lines.zh: 月亮说今晚可以出来玩。
lines.en: The moon said I could come out and play tonight.

lines.zh: 我揉着眼睛，还没睡醒。
lines.en: I rub my eyes, still not fully awake.

lines.zh: 这里的花比我家那边多。
lines.en: There are more flowers here than where I live.

lines.zh: 我数了三颗星星，才敢现身。
lines.en: I counted three stars before showing myself.

lines.zh: 一阵风把我吹来了。
lines.en: A gust of wind carried me here.

lines.zh: 我把光调亮，好看看这是哪。
lines.en: I brighten my glow to see where I am.

lines.zh: 月光漏过叶缝，我先露半张脸。
lines.en: Moonlight slips through the leaves; I show half my face first.

lines.zh: 夜这么长，我慢慢走。
lines.en: The night is long; I will take my time.

lines.zh: 火光太亮，我的眼睛疼。
lines.en: Fire is too bright; my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，光都摔碎了。
lines.en: Falling from that height shattered my light.

lines.zh: 水把光浇灭了，我喘不上气。
lines.en: The water put my light out, and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我耳朵里全是嗡鸣。
lines.en: A blast, and my ears are full of ringing.

lines.zh: 那颗东西擦过我的光。
lines.en: That thing grazed my light.

lines.zh: 符卡的光压过来，我抬不起手。
lines.en: The spell card's light bears down; I cannot lift my hand.

lines.zh: 糖吃完了，我饿得没力气发光。
lines.en: My candy is gone, and I am too hungry to glow.

lines.zh: 雷光比月亮亮太多了。
lines.en: The lightning is far brighter than the moon.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我的光掉进去了。
lines.en: Below is emptiness, and my light fell in.
